messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

The user wants to calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air under different conditions: container volume 2.5 m^3 at 300 K, same volume at 350 K, and then volume 1.5 m^3 at 300 K? Wait: "I will repeat this experiment at higher temperature 350°C" - but they said 350°C? Actually they said 350°C? They wrote "350開氏度" which is 350 K? Wait, "開氏度" means Kelvin? Actually "開氏度" is Kelvin. So 300 K and 350 K. Then lower volume 1.5 m^3 at same temperature? They said "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗". That implies same temperature? Probably 300 K again? But maybe they want 300 K at 1.5 m^3. Or maybe 350 K at 1.5 m^3? The phrase "下一樣重複這個實驗" could mean repeating the experiment at lower volume. It might be at the same temperatures? Hard to parse. Let's interpret: They have three experiments: (1) V=2.5 m^3, T=300 K; (2) V=2.5 m^3, T=350 K; (3) V=1.5 m^3, T=300 K. Or maybe (3) V=1.5 m^3, T=350 K. But likely they want all combinations? The phrase "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" suggests they will repeat the experiment at lower volume, presumably at the same temperatures? But they didn't specify temperature for the third experiment. Could be both temperatures? But they only mention "在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗". That could mean at the same temperature as before? But we had two temperatures: 300 K and 350 K. So maybe they want to repeat at lower volume for both temperatures? But they only ask for "三種不同條件下的熱容量". So they want three conditions: (1) V=2.5 m^3, T=300 K; (2) V=2.5 m^3, T=350 K; (3) V=1.5 m^3, T=300 K. That seems plausible.

We need to compute heat capacity at constant pressure of air. We can use the function calc_heat_capacity. Provide temp in Kelvin, volume in m^3, gas default air. We'll call it thrice.
